rationale: Independent reading: EO 8226 (4 FR 3722, [No. 8226]) only rewrites sec. 15 of EO 7845 (annual leave). Held EO 8384 (5 FR 1253; Sec. 21 sits before the [No. 8384] signature line, so it belongs to EO 8384, not EO 8385) says 'This order shall supersede Executive Orders No. 7845 ..., No. 7879 ..., and No. 8226 of August 24, 1939', effective March 2, 1940. Named whole supersession; Sec. 20 ratifies/revokes departmental regulations only, no savings for EO 8226. I agree: NO. The ACT id is labelled >EO:8385 because the 5 FR 1256 file overlaps the page; the operative text is EO 8384's.
